paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 6, speaking before R' Yasa in Rabbi Acha’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The whole saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni4:6 paragraph supports Bun bar Kohen speaking before Yosea in Acha's name and locally supplies full Rabbi titles. Hyman's unpointed יסא and the local digital יֹסֵא have the same consonants. The inherited English Yasa remains beside the digital vocalization Yosea; an earlier occurrence in the paragraph is vocalized Yasa. This is a vocalization distinction, not a spelling emendation or an authority identity binding. Avin remains Hyman's parenthetical heading variant rather than an independently established identity. The cited digital paragraph supports the Jerusalem Talmud locator without establishing printed pagination or correction history. No legal content or additional figures from the paragraph are imported. All earlier English and historical model judgments remain archived.
